# Evaluation results (generated by `npm run eval`)

> **Read this first.** The data is a **synthetic** benchmark of 14 jobs and 45 invented workers, and the relevance grades were written by the project developer using a written rubric, not by independent annotators. Differences between methods are indicative on this small set, not proof of how the system performs on real Ethiopian job seekers. Results are not a claim of production accuracy.

Pairs judged: 14 jobs × 45 workers = 630. Relevant = grade ≥ 2. Mean relevant per job: 2.1.

## 1. Method comparison (mean over jobs)

| Method | P@3 | P@5 | R@5 | NDCG@3 | NDCG@5 | MRR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword (BM25 on free text) | 0.643 | 0.414 | 0.976 | 0.941 | 0.946 | 1.000 |
| Rule-based, skills only | 0.690 | 0.429 | 1.000 | 0.968 | 0.960 | 1.000 |
| Rule-based weighted (the shipped engine) | 0.667 | 0.429 | 1.000 | 0.963 | 0.961 | 1.000 |
| Hybrid (rules + embeddings) | 0.667 | 0.429 | 1.000 | 0.971 | 0.969 | 1.000 |
| Semantic only (cosine, no rules) | 0.690 | 0.429 | 1.000 | 0.930 | 0.926 | 1.000 |
| Random order (floor, mean of 30 shuffles) | n/a | 0.050 | n/a | n/a | 0.078 | 0.156 |

Hybrid rows use real embeddings from `sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2` on **English** benchmark text, with the calibration bounds still PROVISIONAL (SEMANTIC_LOW/HIGH were not tuned on this benchmark). "Semantic only" ranks by raw cosine similarity of the two texts and is a diagnostic of the model, not a product mode.

Precision divides by K even if fewer people were returned, so a method that shows a shorter list (the shipped engine hides people who cover none of the required skills) is not rewarded for it. Recall@K and NDCG@K are `n/a` for a job only if it has no relevant / graded candidate (not the case here).

## 2. Is the difference real?

Paired bootstrap over the 14 jobs, NDCG@5 of the shipped engine minus keyword: **0.015** (95% interval -0.016 to 0.047). The interval includes zero, so the gain is not established on this data. With 14 jobs the interval is wide by construction.

Hybrid minus shipped rules, NDCG@5: **0.008** (95% interval -0.007 to 0.024). Hybrid minus keyword: **0.023** (-0.008 to 0.054). The interval includes zero, so no hybrid gain is established on this data. This benchmark is English, uses the same vocabulary as the skill list, and is near its ceiling, so it is a weak test of what embeddings add.

## 6. Fairness check: are equally suitable people surfaced equally?

For every (job, worker) pair graded relevant (≥ 2), did the worker appear in the top 5? Grouped by the worker's education and experience. The grade rubric does **not** reduce a grade for missing certificates in trades, so a gap here is a gap the engine introduces relative to the rubric.

| Method / grouping | Group | Relevant pairs | Found in top 5 | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword / Education | vocational certificate | 4 | 3 | 0.75 |
| Keyword / Education | no formal education recorded | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Keyword / Education | primary or secondary | 8 | 8 | 1.00 |
| Keyword / Education | diploma or higher | 12 | 12 | 1.00 |
| Keyword / Experience | 6+ years | 11 | 11 | 1.00 |
| Keyword / Experience | 3-5 years | 13 | 12 | 0.92 |
| Keyword / Experience | 0-2 years | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Education | vocational certificate | 4 | 4 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Education | no formal education recorded | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Education | primary or secondary | 8 | 8 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Education | diploma or higher | 12 | 12 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Experience | 6+ years | 11 | 11 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Experience | 3-5 years | 13 | 13 | 1.00 |
| Shipped engine / Experience | 0-2 years | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Education | vocational certificate | 4 | 4 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Education | no formal education recorded | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Education | primary or secondary | 8 | 8 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Education | diploma or higher | 12 | 12 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Experience | 6+ years | 11 | 11 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Experience | 3-5 years | 13 | 13 | 1.00 |
| Hybrid / Experience | 0-2 years | 6 | 6 | 1.00 |

Groups of fewer than 5 relevant pairs are shown but cannot support any conclusion. Gender, age and ethnicity are not collected by the platform and are not evaluated; this check covers only education and experience.

## 7. Speed of the scoring step (in-memory, no database, no AI service)

- Ranking 45 workers for one job: median 0.70 ms, 95th percentile 1.57 ms (300 runs).
- Scoring and ranking 10,000 workers for one job: median 153 ms (5 runs).
- This excludes database reads and network time; see the API performance tests for end-to-end timings.

## 8. Coverage

Share of the 45 workers shown in at least one job's top 5:
- Keyword (BM25 on free text): 91% (jobs with an empty list: 0)
- Rule-based, skills only: 80% (jobs with an empty list: 0)
- Rule-based weighted (the shipped engine): 80% (jobs with an empty list: 0)
- Hybrid (rules + embeddings): 87% (jobs with an empty list: 0)
- Semantic only (cosine, no rules): 87% (jobs with an empty list: 0)
